name: Y Level
description: The height coordinate: where ores and sky bands sit.

pages.title: Y Level
pages.text:
The **Y level** is your height in the world, shown on the F3 screen. Lower numbers are deeper, and the Overworld goes below zero.\
\
The Ore Guide gives ore depths in Y. Water above Y 100 or below Y 48 is one step cleaner, and Cold Sweat: Altitude gets colder with Y.
